House Bill 416 (COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) (AS PASSED HOUSE AND SENATE) By: Representatives Efstration of the 104th, Blackmon of the 146th, and Kelley of the 16th
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Chapter 88 of Title 36 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to … in effect for the full ten-year period established by Code Section 36-88-8, regardless of the termination of the designation of the enterprise zone."
SECTION 3. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
